analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported its H1 FY26 financial results with revenue of Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA of Rs. 13.43 crore, and PAT of Rs. 7.20 crore. Management noted that the company is expanding its portfolio into new categories such as Soya Chunks and a new vertical for puja and devotional products named Neihaa Narayan.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 will be better than H1 in terms of margins and revenue.
guidance.quote: So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to utilize about 30% of its oil capacity in H2.
guidance.quote: Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 to be the best year in the company's past complete history.
guidance.quote: As I said, new products are launched, so might be 100% will achieve. Exactly, I can't comment on that. But it will be better than, FY '27 will be the best in our past complete history.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately six percent from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the groundnut oil category constitutes about 7% to 8% of the overall sales in the oil segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Generally, overall if you see the positioning of the groundnut oil is percentage wise 7% to 8% is the overall sales of this oil segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that sesame oil and safflower oil account for 1% to 2% of market share.
demand_outlook.quote: Sesame oil and safflower oil, it is 1% to 2% of market share.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that about 70% of the spices market is in the unorganized trade and is expected to shift to organized trade by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade. So, after the post COVID, now people are moving to the packaging and quality products. So, 70% will now come down by 2030, we are expecting 70% will be the organized trade.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that 70% of atta is in the loose unorganized form.
demand_outlook.quote: As well as atta is also same, 70% is in the loose atta which is unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, and festival-related items.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning for a plant for Soya Chunks after two quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: After one shield kit, just standard shields, we will go for the plant. Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai on July 28, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: The installed capacity is 3,600 tons per annum for spices and masalas, 14,400 tons per annum for atta, and 7,200 tons per annum for oil.
capex_expansion.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons. When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons. Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue for H1 FY26 stood at Rs. 78.77 crores with an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue stood at Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA at Rs. 13.43 crore and PAT at Rs. 7.20 crore. Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management confirmed that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 was reported at 17.05 percent.
For pulses, grains, and whole spices, the cart value is 40% to 45% with margins of 30% to 35%.
margins_costs.quote: and pulses and grains and whole space cart value will be 40% to 45% and margins with 30% to 35%.

margins_costs.claim: For oil, ghee, and other products, the cart value is 15% to 20% with margins of 18% to 22%.
margins_costs.quote: And oil and ghee and other products, cart value will be 15% to 20%; margins will be 18% to 22%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and depreciation claimed for 6 months.
margins_costs.quote: Our PAT has been decreased. See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity and utilization figures were provided as 3,600 tons installed and 2,637 tons utilized for Spices, 14,400 tons installed and 12,650 tons utilized for Atta, and 7,200 tons installed and 720 tons utilized for Oil.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons. And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons. When it comes to Oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons and we have utilized 720 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on October 10, 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the entire amount raised from the rights issue has been utilized for specified objects without deviation.
capital_allocation.quote: So, as disclosed in the letter of offer, we have utilized the entire amount for the specified purpose without any deviation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that expanding geographically into new states like Maharashtra presents challenges due to entrenched existing brands and high advertising costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because when we go for the placement of the new product in a new region, it will be quite tough. It will take at least a year to get the proper placement also. So, it will dent our profitability as well as the network also, to build the network.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the new puja and devotional products brand Neihaa Narayan will be launched in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that all oil products will be placed in the complete marketplaces by the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: All the oil product will be placed in the complete marketplaces.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets 300 deliveries per day on the Poushtik platform within a time frame of six months over two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: within the six months of time frame, in the two quarters, we are targeting per day targeting deliveries of 300 deliveries.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to start exports in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: definitely we are the second, H2, we are going to start the export.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
